planningOnlyNumbers.note: These counts are comparison targets for Product pacing review, not locked production thresholds.

stages.label: Entered Service
stages.function: Invitation accepted; first-day orientation and basic Palace work begin.

stages.label: Trusted Service
stages.function: The heroine is established enough for professional relationships, optional Night context and outcome preparation.

stages.label: Outcome Ready
stages.function: General Palace progression is complete; non-True outcomes may resolve and True confrontation may become available if 12x91 readiness is also met.

advancement.repeatableWork: One generic Palace daytime work/duty completion increments palace.completed_duties. Exact production action ID, wage/stat effects and per-day cadence remain separate implementation decisions.
trustedServiceToOutcomeReady: Resolve one topology-neutral capstone work event.
No relationship, romance, legacy item or voluntary Night choice is required.
advancement.expectedRepetition: About 8 Palace duty completions plus 2 authored progression milestones. Because D26 is locked to the ten ordinary professions only, this packet does not impose one Palace duty per day.

night.palace.night.work-review: available after orientation from entered-service onward

nonTrueOutcomeBranchPoints.branchPoint: Completion-only Service Life resolution event after general Palace progression completes.
nonTrueOutcomeBranchPoints.baselinePath: General Palace work continuity; relationships/items/Night may add variants but are not required.

nonTrueOutcomeBranchPoints.branchPoint: Completion-only Court Power resolution event after general Palace progression completes.
nonTrueOutcomeBranchPoints.baselinePath: Professional responsibility/network route; patron, rival and official-contact relationship states may add responses. Romance is never required.

nonTrueOutcomeBranchPoints.branchPoint: Completion-only Inner Truth resolution event after general Palace progression completes.
nonTrueOutcomeBranchPoints.baselinePath: A neutral evidence/interpretation work path must exist; legacy-item and Night evidence options may add variants but cannot be mandatory.

saveReload.events: Existing pendingScene and reaction.queued persist latched progression/branch scenes.
saveReload.nights: Existing NightFlow persistence applies; Palace voluntary Night never owns forced Night.
saveReload.replayRule: Reload never recomputes a completed stage from scratch; serialized stage/counter/facts remain authoritative for the run.

authoredProductionCost.implementationSurface: one Palace career machine + repeatable work action + 5-7 progression/outcome events + localization/UI exposure

riskAssessment.mainFailureMode: After a very long 10-career meta journey, Palace itself may feel compressed if 8 duties and two transitions make relationships/outcome families appear too quickly.
riskAssessment.mitigation: Require orientation + neutral capstone and distribute existing relationship scenes between trusted-service and outcome-ready rather than firing them immediately.

stages.label: Entered Service
stages.function: Invitation accepted; orientation and first practical duties.

stages.label: Working Rhythm
stages.function: Routine Palace work is understood; practical contact and early optional legacy variants attach here.

stages.label: Trusted Service
stages.function: The heroine receives broader responsibility; professional patron/rival routes and Service Life branch preparation become meaningful.

stages.label: Palace Network
stages.function: Cross-service coordination and professional relationship depth; Court Power branch preparation attaches here.

stages.label: Crossroads
stages.function: Later responsibility/evidence/interpretation choices converge; Inner Truth branch preparation attaches here.

stages.label: Outcome Ready
stages.function: General Palace progression is complete; all completion-only outcome checks and True confrontation gate can evaluate.

advancement.repeatableWork: One generic Palace daytime work/duty completion increments palace.completed_duties. Exact production action ID, rewards and cadence remain separate implementation decisions.
stageTargets: entered-service -> working-rhythm: orientation complete + 2 total duties
trusted-service -> palace-network: 8 total duties + coordination milestone
palace-network -> crossroads: 12 total duties + network milestone
crossroads -> outcome-ready: 15 total duties + neutral capstone
advancement.expectedRepetition: About 15 Palace duty completions plus 4-5 authored stage milestones. This packet does not impose the ordinary one-same-career-shift-per-day rule on Palace.

nonTrueOutcomeBranchPoints.branchPoint: At trusted-service, an optional continuity-of-service event can mark Service Life intent/readiness preparation.
nonTrueOutcomeBranchPoints.baselinePath: Palace duties alone provide a baseline route; optional contact/Night variants deepen the scene.

nonTrueOutcomeBranchPoints.branchPoint: At palace-network, a professional responsibility/network event begins Court Power preparation.
nonTrueOutcomeBranchPoints.baselinePath: Professional patron/rival/official-contact states can branch responses; romance remains irrelevant.

nonTrueOutcomeBranchPoints.branchPoint: At crossroads, an evidence/interpretation event begins Inner Truth preparation.
nonTrueOutcomeBranchPoints.baselinePath: A no-item work/evidence route is mandatory; legacy capabilities and voluntary Night can expose alternate evidence handling.

saveReload.careerState: Existing run.progression.careers['palace'] persists stage/counters/facts/choices across all six stages.
saveReload.events: Latched stage-milestone and branch scenes persist pending/queued identity and allowed choices.
saveReload.relationships: Existing relationship state persists independently of Palace stage; stage gates only control when scenes can first appear.
saveReload.nights: Existing NightFlow persistence applies; forced Night remains owned elsewhere.
saveReload.replayRule: Reload resumes the serialized stage plus any pending milestone; it must not auto-skip intermediate stages because the duty counter is already above a later threshold.

authoredProductionCost.implementationSurface: one six-stage Palace career machine + repeatable work action + 10-14 progression/outcome events + more stage-gated localization/UI states

riskAssessment.mainFailureMode: If all 15 duties are the same button, the extra stages become cosmetic gates and Palace can feel like another ordinary grind after the user already earned ten Hard Works.
riskAssessment.mitigation: Each middle stage must unlock a distinct authored surface or work-context choice; relationships/items/Night remain optional, while milestone events make stage changes perceptible without requiring 50-shift pacing.

shared: Same palace.progression-complete signal for v9 confrontation gating.
Same all-12 >=91 True readiness and Lust exclusion.
Same separate Prince-defeat and Return Home ending commit.
No item/relationship/romance/Night requirement for general Palace progression.

compact.strongestAdvantage: Lowest production and regression surface; Palace feels like a short capstone route after the long 10-career Meta journey.
compact.strongestRisk: Relationship and outcome content crowds into only two post-entry states, making Palace progression feel abrupt.

rich.strongestAdvantage: Clear pacing space for existing v5 relationships, optional Night and three outcome families without stacking them into one final stage.
rich.strongestRisk: Can become grindy or cosmetically over-staged if stage changes are driven by repeated identical work.

acceptanceMatrix.assertion: D23 invitation/access remains external to Palace progression stages and has no second gate.
Palace progression begins only after palace.access-granted.
General progression to outcome-ready requires no romance, relationship, legacy item or voluntary Night choice.
No Palace stage or ending grants hardWork:palace or contributes to ordinary 10/10.
palace.progression-complete is emitted exactly once on entry to outcome-ready.
Prince confrontation cannot become available before palace.progression-complete.
Prince confrontation additionally requires all 12 progression stats >=91 and excludes Lust.
A cap-200 run still uses raw >=91 rather than a normalized threshold.
Service Life, Court Power and Inner Truth remain completion-only; preparation does not auto-end or block True route.
Optional romance refusal never blocks Palace progression or any ending family.
Legacy item capabilities only add variants/choices and never substitute for Palace access or progression requirements.
Palace voluntary Night does not own forced Night and cannot bypass a separate forced-Night owner.
Save/reload preserves Palace career stage, duty counters, facts, choices, pending scene and queued latched events.
Reload with a high duty counter does not auto-skip unresolved intermediate milestone events.
Compact topology has exactly 3 stages and completes general progression at 8 planned duty completions plus capstone.
All three non-True outcome branch resolutions attach at outcome-ready and remain distinct.
Rich topology has exactly 6 stages with planning targets 2,5,8,12,15 duties.
Service Life preparation attaches at trusted-service, Court Power at palace-network, Inner Truth at crossroads.
All three non-True outcomes still resolve only after outcome-ready despite earlier preparation points.
No Prince name/lore or final confrontation mechanics are introduced by the topology decision.

leaderDecisionQuestions: Are the planning targets (~8 vs ~15 Palace duty completions) acceptable as pacing envelopes, with exact thresholds left to the implementation/balance pass?
Should non-True branch preparation remain non-exclusive until the player commits an ending, or should Product later require one branch choice to lock the other non-True families?
Should Palace duty cadence remain unrestricted by D26, or should a separate Palace-specific per-day cadence be decided later?
explicitNonGoals: No choice among v9 confrontation models.
No Palace-specific daily pacing rule is invented.
